description.text: ThemajorofElectronicand InformationEngineering has been enrolled since 2004. It has been listed as acharacteristic specialtyof the University in 2013, and approved as afirst-class professional construction sitein Zhejiang Province in 2019.This program constructs the professional curriculum system according to the national engineering education certification standards. The professional courses cover the field of electronic information. Students can not only learn the basic knowledge of electronic information, but also deeply study the embedded software and hardware, algorithm of signal acquisition, processing and transmission, automatic control technology and electronic hardware and software, etc. Relying on the provincial key construction of information technology experimental teaching demonstration center and the National and Provincial Discipline scientific research platform, the theoretical teaching and practical ability training can be carried out simultaneously which strengthens the engineering practice ability and innovation ability for. The graduates can be engaged in the design and development, operation and maintenance and management in the fields of electronic information industry.This major cultivates applied engineering and technical talents, who can meet the needs of social and economic development, serve the development needs of enterprises in the information industry, and can be engaged in the design, development, application, integration, testing, operation and maintenance and management in the fields of electronic technique, information and communication, industrial control, acquisition and processing of signal, computer application, and other aspects.The following objectives should be achieved:①Graduateshave good professional ethics and have a sense of social responsibility, dedication, safety and environmental awareness in work, and be able to actively serve the society.②Graduateshave rich and professional work experience, and have the ability to provide effective solutions for complex practical engineering problems in electronic information and related fields by comprehensively using the knowledge and skill in electronic information engineering and related disciplines.③Graduates areable to continuously track the cutting-edge technologies in electronic information engineering, be able to expand and innovate according to the need of the practical engineering, and apply these for the innovation development and industrial upgrading in electronic information field.④Graduateshave a healthy body and mind, have the coordination and communication ability, project manage ability and economic decision-making ability, and act as backbone or leader in a team.⑤Graduates areable to persistently upgrade knowledge or engineering ability and improve the social work ability or professional technology standardby continuing education or other lifelong learning sources.

duration.text: The Electronic and Information Engineering at Zhejiang Agriculture and Forestry University is a 4 Years long program for international students, taught in English.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 2777 USD/per year ￥ 20000 CNY/per year

materials.text: For the students who have never studied in China：1.The Photocopy of Passport (the main page and the page with signature) 2.Translated and notarized copy of final degree or diploma and transcript3.Language proficiency certificate4.Non-criminal record or Chinese/English-translated document with an official stamp.5.Other certificates or documents 6.Foreigner physical examination form: bearing the stamp of the hospital. Physical examination results are valid for 6 months7.Application Form For School8.Family Information Form9.Financial Income Statement10.A Short Video of Self Introduction11.Commitment without Drug Use History 12.Photo（format: JPG format, color, 2-inch ID photo, white background , the head occupies 2/3 of the photo, no less than 320 * 240 pixels, aspect ratio is 4: 3, the size is 100-500KB.）For the transferred students who have already studied in China：1.The Photocopy of Passport (the main page and the page with signature) and Visa page2.Translated and notarized copy of final degree or diploma and transcript3.Last semester transcript in the previous school4.Language proficiency certificate5.Non-criminal record or Chinese/English-translated document with an official stamp.6.Transfer letter from last school include the attendance and performance 7.certificate of verification from Entry-Exit inspection and Quarantine within 6 months8.Application Form For School9.Family Information Form10. Financial Income Statement11.A Short Video of Self Introduction12.Commitment without Drug Use History 13.Photo（format: JPG format, color, 2-inch ID photo, white background , the head occupies 2/3 of the photo, no less than 320 * 240 pixels, aspect ratio is 4: 3, the size is 100-500KB.）

requirements.text: 1. Applicants should be aged between 18 and 282.Applicant should be non-Chinese citizens with valid regular foreign passport and be friendly to China; *Residents of China who have emigrated to a foreign country and who are now applying to study in China as international students must have held a valid foreign passport for at least 4 years, and must have actually resided in a foreign country for at least 2 years in the past 4 years. (9 months of residence in a foreign country may count as a full year. The dates of the entry and exit stamps in the passport will be followed in the determination of the actual length of foreign residence).
